parts.name: bottle shell

physics.Basic_description: Light blue cylindrical plastic body with a smooth matte finish, forming the main container volume.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the liquid product and provides the structural form for the dispenser.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical midsection firmly with parallel jaws to support the object's weight.
physics.reason: Standard blow-molded plastic bottle construction implies a thin wall enclosing an air/liquid volume.

parts.description: Light blue cylindrical plastic body with a smooth matte finish, forming the main container volume.
parts.function: Holds the liquid product and provides the structural form for the dispenser.

parts.name: front label

physics.Basic_description: Small green rectangular patch adhered to the side of the bottle body.
physics.Functional_description: Displays product branding or usage instructions.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flat to be grasped independently; would be crushed or ignored by a gripper.
physics.reason: A label is a thin sheet of material, effectively solid in this context as it has no enclosed void.

parts.description: Small green rectangular patch adhered to the side of the bottle body.
parts.function: Displays product branding or usage instructions.

parts.name: liquid fill

physics.Basic_description: Blue region visible through the translucent bottle walls representing the fluid contents.
physics.Functional_description: The consumable product (e.g., soap, lotion) stored inside the container.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal fluid cannot be grasped directly; manipulation occurs via the container walls.
physics.reason: Modeled as a volume filling the interior, treated as a continuous medium (solid approximation for physics).

parts.description: Blue region visible through the translucent bottle walls representing the fluid contents.
parts.function: The consumable product (e.g., soap, lotion) stored inside the container.

parts.name: collar shell

physics.Basic_description: White ribbed cylindrical ring at the top neck of the bottle.
physics.Functional_description: Threads onto the bottle neck to secure the pump mechanism and allow rotation for locking/unlocking.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the ribbed outer surface to rotate or stabilize the pump assembly relative to the bottle.
physics.reason: Injection molded screw cap component with a central bore for the dip tube.

parts.description: White ribbed cylindrical ring at the top neck of the bottle.
parts.function: Threads onto the bottle neck to secure the pump mechanism and allow rotation for locking/unlocking.

parts.name: lock ring shell

physics.Basic_description: Small orange ring detail located at the base of the pump head assembly.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a safety lock or visual indicator for the pump mechanism status.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and recessed to be a primary grasp target; likely manipulated indirectly.
physics.reason: Small plastic ring component surrounding the pump stem.

parts.description: Small orange ring detail located at the base of the pump head assembly.
parts.function: Acts as a safety lock or visual indicator for the pump mechanism status.

parts.name: pump head shell

physics.Basic_description: Purple/blue upper housing of the pump mechanism sitting atop the collar.
physics.Functional_description: Contains the spring and piston mechanism; pressed down to dispense liquid.
physics.Grasped_description: Press down vertically on the top surface or grasp the sides to actuate the pump.
physics.reason: Complex injection molded housing enclosing internal mechanical components and air.

parts.description: Purple/blue upper housing of the pump mechanism sitting atop the collar.
parts.function: Contains the spring and piston mechanism; pressed down to dispense liquid.

parts.name: dip tube

physics.Basic_description: Long, thin, flexible cyan tube extending downwards from the bottle base in the view (or internally).
physics.Functional_description: Draws liquid from the bottom of the bottle up to the pump head.
physics.Grasped_description: Flexible and thin; not a stable grasp point for manipulating the whole object.
physics.reason: Extruded plastic tubing designed to channel fluid, inherently hollow.

parts.description: Long, thin, flexible cyan tube extending downwards from the bottle base in the view (or internally).
parts.function: Draws liquid from the bottom of the bottle up to the pump head.

parts.name: spout shell

physics.Basic_description: Magenta curved nozzle extending horizontally from the pump head.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the dispensed liquid stream away from the bottle.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be pinched gently, but fragile; better to avoid grasping here to prevent breakage.
physics.reason: Thin-walled plastic nozzle with a central channel for fluid exit.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
